articles.title_en: The High and Falling Price of Cement in Africa
articles.title_cn: 非洲水泥价格的高企与回落
articles.abstract_en: Prices for several intermediate inputs, including cement, are higher in developing economies—particularly in Africa. Combining recent data from the International Comparison Program with a global directory of cement firms, we estimate an industry equilibrium model to distinguish between drivers of international price dispersion: demand, costs, conduct, and entry. Developing economies feature both higher marginal costs and higher markups. African markets are not characterized by less competitive conduct and, if anything, feature lower barriers to entry. Yet the small size of many national markets limits entry and competition and explains most of the higher markups and prices. Policy implications are discussed. (JEL D24, L13, L61, O14)
articles.abstract_cn: 包括水泥在内的几种中间投入品在发展中经济体——尤其是非洲——的价格较高。结合国际比较项目的最新数据与全球水泥企业名录，我们估计了一个行业均衡模型，以区分国际价格差异的驱动因素：需求、成本、行为和进入。发展中经济体既具有较高的边际成本，也具有较高的加成率。非洲市场并非以较不竞争的行为为特征，如果有的话，其进入壁垒较低。然而，许多国家市场的规模较小限制了进入和竞争，并解释了大部分较高的加成率和价格。讨论了政策含义。(JEL D24, L13, L61, O14)

articles.title_en: Wind of Change? Cultural Determinants of Maternal Labor Supply
articles.title_cn: 变革之风？文化对女性劳动供给的决定因素
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the role of cultural norms in shaping women’s labor supply decisions after childbirth. Specifically, we are interested in the interplay between childhood socialization and adulthood environment. To that end, we leverage the setting of the German reunification when East Germany’s gender-egalitarian culture induced by socialism and West Germany’s more traditional culture were brought together. We find that East German gender norms are persistent, whereas West German ones are not. West German mothers adjust their behavior to that of their East German peers not only when immersed in East German environment but even after returning to the West. (JEL D91, J13, J16, J22, N34, Z13)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了文化规范在塑造女性生育后劳动供给决策中的作用。具体而言，我们关注童年社会化与成年环境之间的相互作用。为此，我们利用了德国统一这一背景，当时社会主义所导致的东德性别平等文化与西德更为传统的文化被结合在一起。我们发现东德的性别规范具有持续性，而西德的则不然。西德母亲不仅在东德环境中会调整其行为以与东德同龄人保持一致，甚至在返回西德后也是如此。（JEL D91, J13, J16, J22, N34, Z13）

articles.title_en: Childcare, Labor Supply, and Business Development: Experimental Evidence from Uganda
articles.title_cn: 儿童保育、劳动力供给与商业发展：来自乌干达的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: We randomly offered a childcare subsidy, an equivalent cash grant, or both to mothers of three-to-five-year-old children. The childcare subsidy substantially increased the labor supply and earnings of single mothers, highlighting the importance of time constraints for them. Among couples, childcare did not affect mothers’ labor market outcomes but instead increased fathers’ salaried employment. At the household level, childcare led to higher income and consumption and improved child development. Cash grants positively affected mothers’ labor supply and income irrespective of the household structure, suggesting the general importance of credit constraints for women’s business development. (JEL H24, J13, J16, J22, J31, O12)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们随机向三至五岁儿童的母亲提供儿童保育补贴、等额现金赠款，或两者兼有。儿童保育补贴显著增加了单身母亲的劳动力供给和收入，凸显了时间约束对她们的重要性。在夫妻家庭中，儿童保育并未影响母亲的劳动力市场结果，反而增加了父亲的受薪就业。在家庭层面，儿童保育带来了更高的收入和消费，并促进了儿童发展。现金赠款无论家庭结构如何，都对母亲的劳动力供给和收入产生了积极影响，这表明信贷约束对女性商业发展具有普遍重要性。(JEL H24, J13, J16, J22, J31, O12)

articles.title_en: Sustainable Poverty Reduction through Social Assistance: Modality, Context, and Complementary Programming in Bangladesh
articles.title_cn: 通过社会救助实现可持续减贫：孟加拉国的模式、背景与补充项目
articles.abstract_en: Social assistance programs can increase consumption and reduce poverty, but less is known about whether these impacts are sustained after programs end or how design and context influence sustainability. Using data collected in two regions of Bangladesh four years after a randomized intervention ended, we find that combining cash transfers with complementary programming led to sustained increases in consumption and reductions in poverty. Combining food transfers with complementary programming showed similar patterns to a lesser extent. Cash alone had context-specific sustained effects; food alone had no sustained impacts. Results suggest that context, modality, and complementary programming matter for sustained impacts. (JEL D12, E21, I32, I38, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 社会救助项目可以增加消费并减少贫困，但关于这些影响在项目结束后是否持续，以及设计背景和背景如何影响可持续性，我们知之甚少。利用随机干预结束四年后在孟加拉国两个地区收集的数据，我们发现，将现金转移与补充项目相结合，导致了消费的持续增加和贫困的减少。将食品转移与补充项目相结合，显示出类似但程度较轻的模式。仅现金转移具有特定背景下的持续效应；仅食品转移则没有持续影响。结果表明，背景、模式和补充项目对持续影响至关重要。(JEL D12, E21, I32, I38, O15)

articles.title_en: Do Peers Matter in the Police Academy?
articles.title_cn: 警察学院中的同伴效应重要吗？
articles.abstract_en: Increasing underrepresented groups’ representation in police departments is a common proposal to reduce aggressive policing. This paper documents the effects of peer composition in the Chicago police academy on officers’ future arrests by exploiting the lottery system, which provides exogenous variation in cohort composition. I find that higher shares of peers from groups that police less aggressively, such as female and older officers, reduce all officers’ future low-level arrests. Peer race matters by amplifying the effects of gender and age. Overall, the results are most consistent with peers’ preferences for less aggressive policing shifting officers’ preferences and changing future behavior. (JEL H76, J15, J16, J45, J78, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 增加警察部门中代表性不足群体的比例是减少激进警务的常见提议。本文利用抽签系统提供的队列构成外生变异，记录了芝加哥警察学院中同伴构成对警官未来逮捕行为的影响。我发现，来自较少采取激进警务的群体（如女性和年长警官）的同伴比例越高，会减少所有警官未来的低级逮捕。同伴的种族通过放大性别和年龄效应而起作用。总体而言，结果最符合同伴对较少激进警务的偏好转变了警官的偏好并改变了未来行为的解释。(JEL H76, J15, J16, J45, J78, K42)

articles.title_en: The Long-Term Effects of Career Guidance in High School and Student Financial Aid: Evidence from a Randomized Experiment
articles.title_cn: 高中职业指导与学生资助的长期效应：来自随机实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the effects of a randomized control trial in which Canadian high school students were randomly invited to participate in a career guidance program during high school and/or made eligible for extra financial aid conditional on college enrollment. I use administrative records to examine the effects of the interventions on college enrollment, graduation, and income up to age 29. The guidance intervention increased students’ four-year college enrollment and graduation rates and had positive effects on individuals’ income in adulthood. The financial aid intervention had a significantly lower impact on individuals’ income in adulthood despite also increasing college enrollment. (JEL D12, I21, I22, I23, I28, J31)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一项随机对照试验的效果，在该试验中，加拿大高中生被随机邀请参加高中期间的职业指导项目和/或有资格在入学大学后获得额外经济援助。我使用行政记录来考察这些干预措施对大学入学、毕业以及至29岁收入的影响。指导干预提高了学生的四年制大学入学率和毕业率，并对个体成年后的收入产生了积极影响。经济援助干预虽然也增加了大学入学率，但对个体成年后收入的影响显著较低。(JEL D12, I21, I22, I23, I28, J31)

articles.title_en: The Productivity Consequences of Pollution-Induced Migration in China
articles.title_cn: 污染引发的迁移对中国生产率的影响
articles.abstract_en: We quantify how pollution affects aggregate productivity and welfare in spatial equilibrium. We show that skilled workers in China emigrate away from polluted cities. These patterns are evident under various empirical specifications, such as when instrumenting for pollution using upwind power plants, or thermal inversions. Pollution changes the spatial distribution of skilled and unskilled workers, and wage returns by location. We quantify the loss in aggregate productivity due to this re-sorting by estimating a spatial equilibrium model. Counterfactual simulations show that reducing pollution increases productivity through spatial re-sorting by approximately as much as the direct health benefits of clean air. (JEL J24, J31, J61, P25, P28, Q53, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们量化了污染如何在空间均衡中影响总生产率和福利。我们表明，中国的技能工人会从污染严重的城市迁出。这些模式在各种实证设定下都很明显，例如使用上风电厂或热逆温作为污染的工具变量时。污染改变了技能工人和非技能工人的空间分布，以及不同地点的工资回报。我们通过估计一个空间均衡模型来量化这种重新分类导致的总生产率损失。反事实模拟显示，减少污染通过空间重新分类提高生产率，其幅度大约与清洁空气的直接健康效益相当。(JEL J24, J31, J61, P25, P28, Q53, R23)

articles.title_en: Family Spillover Effects of Marginal Diagnoses: The Case of ADHD
articles.title_cn: 边际诊断的家庭溢出效应：以注意力缺陷多动障碍为例
articles.abstract_en: The health care system uses patient family medical history in many settings, and this practice is widely believed to improve the efficiency of health care allocation. This paper provides a counterpoint by documenting that reliance on hereditary information can amplify the misallocation of low-value care. We study Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder and show that reliance on family medical history generates a “snowball effect”—the propagation of an original marginal diagnosis to a patient’s relatives. This snowball effect raises the private and social costs of low-value care. (JEL H51, I12, I13, I18, J12, J13)
articles.abstract_cn: 医疗系统在许多情境下使用患者的家族病史，这种做法被广泛认为能提高医疗资源配置的效率。本文通过记录依赖遗传信息可能加剧低价值护理的错配，提供了一个反例。我们研究注意力缺陷多动障碍，并表明依赖家族病史会产生“滚雪球效应”——即原始边际诊断向患者亲属的传播。这种滚雪球效应提高了低价值护理的私人成本和社会成本。(JEL H51, I12, I13, I18, J12, J13)
